completion_gate: Driver authored complete with an unexecuted real-arm entry point and its sha256 recorded; CALIBRATION_AUTHORIZATION gate respected; CAL-1, CAL-2, CAL-3 and CAL-4 complete at both bit sizes or an honest incomplete report; every arm at n = 130816 or reported short; zero c_2 = 0 draws recorded and every null redraw counted; no OBJ-REAL sample and no deterministic factor-base x-list anywhere in the package; no factorization, no smoothness statistic, no search arm, no timing decision variable and no R; no threshold frozen; no disposition stated; manifest.yaml present with its required fields and the five companion filenames beside it.
constraints: run_authorized ONLY if TASK-20260801-020 records CALIBRATION_AUTHORIZATION AUTHORIZED; otherwise cancel with no run and say so.

THE CALIBRATION NEVER SEES THE REAL DATA, STRUCTURALLY AND NOT BY INSTRUCTION (ATS-1 clause 2). Enumerate NO half-tuple of the deterministic factor base. Do not invoke the real-arm entry point. The run package must contain no OBJ-REAL sample, no deterministic factor-base x-list and no statistic computed from one.

THE DRIVER IS AUTHORED COMPLETE HERE AND IS NOT EDITED AGAIN (ATS-1 clause 5). The real-arm entry point must be present, reachable and unexecuted. Record the driver sha256 in the calibration manifest; TASK-20260801-027 must execute the IDENTICAL file with no edit.

IMPLEMENT THE FROZEN FORMS EXACTLY AS WRITTEN AND CHOOSE NOTHING. The statistic family, the resolution ladder K in {16, 64}, the binning rule, the plant construction, the delta ladder [0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10], M_PAIRS = 200 and R_REPS = 20 are frozen in the contract. Do not add, drop, retune or substitute any of them.

Enumerate i < j only. The diagonal is excluded BY CONSTRUCTION at n = C(512, 2) = 130816 per sample set. If any arm records a single c_2 = 0 draw, stop and report it - that is an integrity failure, not a datum.
On the null side, maintain 512 DISTINCT x-coordinates by REJECT AND REDRAW on an x-collision, and record the rejection count. This is the only redraw permitted anywhere in this experiment.

Use the frozen streams - master seed 2301, calibration null stream 2301 + 10000 + bits, plant stream 2301 + 20000 + bits, independent-pair stream 2301 + 30000 + bits, uniform-pair stream 2301 + 40000 + bits. DO NOT TOUCH THE REAL-ARM NULL STREAM 2301 + 50000 + bits. Record every stream hash.

The run manifest is manifest.yaml, NOT manifest.json, with companions command.txt, environment.json, stdout.log, stderr.log and raw-result.json - NOTE THE .log RATHER THAN .txt. The manifest must carry id, experiment_id, status, code with commit and command, environment, inputs with parameters, timing and result, and result.certificate.kind must be the literal string none.
Memory policy - retain per-replicate statistic values, stream hashes and one representative OBJ-NULL-RFB draw per cell. Do NOT archive the full 1.4 x 10**8 pairs.

NO FACTORIZATION, NO LARGEST PRIME FACTOR, NO SMOOTHNESS INDICATOR, NO DICKMAN EVALUATION, NO u LADDER, NO SEARCH ARM, NO TIMING DECISION VARIABLE, NO COST IDENTITY AND NO R anywhere in the driver or the package. wall_seconds_total is recorded for budget accounting only.
DO NOT FREEZE ANY THRESHOLD AND DO NOT COMPUTE ANY ORDER-STATISTIC THRESHOLD AS A DECISION. Emit the raw replicate values; TASK-20260801-023 applies THR-EQD-1 to them.
Do NOT classify anything against RR-EQD-1, which does not exist yet, and do not state a disposition of any kind.
THIS RUN IS EXPRESSLY NON-EVIDENTIAL about H-EQD-001, HEUR-DS-1 and H-SMTH-001 in either direction. Do not describe any calibration number as a result about the Semaev map.
Do not read-modify, import, edit or stage any file under experiments/EXP-DS-001/ or experiments/EXP-SMTH-001/.
AP-1 BINDS. Do not set smoothness_abort on any EXP-DS-001 arm and do not represent any such run as exercising anything.
Timeouts, crashes, memory exhaustion and budget cancellation are infrastructure signal, never mathematical negatives (AGENTS.md rule 5).
No new dependencies. If any new dependency proves necessary the run is cancelled and reported, not extended.
MAKE NO COMMIT; TASK-20260801-022 archives.
Record inference fallback honestly (requested executor-implementation).
Do not alter any ledger record. Leave FAEST and XEDN alone.
handoff.objective: TWO ORDERED PHASES IN ONE TASK, AND THE ORDER IS PART OF THE CONTRACT. PHASE A - author experiments/EXP-EQD-001/implementation/eqd001_driver.py COMPLETE, INCLUDING THE REAL-ARM ENTRY POINT THAT IS NOT INVOKED IN THIS TASK, plus implementation.md. PHASE B - execute RUN-EQD-001-calib exactly as experiments/EXP-EQD-001/specification.yaml specifies, on NULL AND PLANTED OBJECTS ONLY - CAL-1 (200 independent replicate pairs of OBJ-NULL-RFB per bit size, recording STAT-CHI-16, STAT-CHI-64, STAT-KS1-E1, STAT-KS1-E2 per pair and STAT-DUP for each of the 400 draws), CAL-2 (20 OBJ-PLANT-delta replicates per delta on the frozen ladder against fresh OBJ-NULL-RFB draws), CAL-3 (20 OBJ-NULL-IND versus OBJ-NULL-RFB comparisons) and CAL-4 (#E(F_p), its 2-adic valuation, |X_E|, and the admissible-support fractions of one OBJ-NULL-UNIF2 draw and one OBJ-NULL-RFB draw), at both bit sizes. Observe and record only. Freeze no threshold, apply no reading rule, and interpret nothing.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: What the frozen statistics actually DO on objects whose law is known - the measured null distribution that THR-EQD-1 will be evaluated against, and the measured power curve that CERT-EQD-1 will be evaluated against.

dispatches.title: Author the EQD driver complete including the unexecuted real-arm entry point, then execute RUN-EQD-001-calib on null and planted objects only

objective: BATCH-023 EXP-EQD-001: measure the joint law of the half-arity Semaev fibre invariants (e_1, e_2) directly, against a MATCHED RANDOM-FACTOR-BASE null, with every threshold calibrated from a MEASURED null distribution before the reading rule is frozen, and with the rejection side of every substantive branch certified by a MEASURED power curve against pre-declared planted deviations. CALIBRATION FIRST. Author the frozen contract and H-EQD-001; snapshot it so THR-EQD-1, CERT-EQD-1, CAL-STOP-1, ATS-1 and the statistic family are hash-bound before any datum exists; author the driver COMPLETE including the real-arm entry point that is not executed, and run RUN-EQD-001-calib on NULL AND PLANTED OBJECTS ONLY; snapshot the driver sha256 and the calibration package; INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATE THAT CALIBRATION PACKAGE before anything is frozen against it; freeze reading_rule.yaml and ATTAIN-RR-EQD-1 against the MEASURED null, or record CAL-STOP-1 non-execution; snapshot the rule; one independent review whose TWO NAMED DUTIES are the attainability check and the ATS-1 anti-tuning check, each with its own deliverable file; approval snapshot; RUN-EQD-001-real only if APPROVED; snapshot; Validator and Red Team; ledger EV-EQD-001 + close decision + H-EQD-001 status + GOAL checkpoint. Toy claim ceiling. NO smoothness, NO factorization, NO Dickman model, NO search, NO timing, NO cost identity, NO R. This measures LIMB L2 and it is NOT a validation or refutation of HEUR-DS-1 in either direction. Do not edit experiments/EXP-SMTH-001/specification.yaml or any EXP-DS-001 artifact. Do not alter H-DS-001, H-IC-001, H-STR-002 or H-SMTH-001. Leave FAEST and XEDN alone.
